result: Final save/backup QA passes backend tests and frontend build. Saves receives role, renders BackupMetadata identity/source/length/hash/timestamp, provides download, owner-only rename/delete/restore controls, uses {confirm:true} for restore, and includes confirmations for destructive UI actions. Backend routes retain CSRF/audit pipeline, stopped-running guards, explicit confirmation, owner enforcement, integrity hash+length validation, traversal-safe paths, retention pruning, and rollback. Rename/delete compensate filesystem changes when metadata persistence fails. Residual atomicity gap: after backup file move, metadata insert failure can leave an unindexed file; prune can similarly leave metadata/file divergence if metadata deletion fails. No focused integration test proves live API role/CSRF behavior; existing suite remains unit/persistence-level.

evidence.outcome: Passed; Vite production build completed with existing SignalR Rollup annotation warnings.
Saves receives me.role; BackupMetadata displays source/length/timestamp/SHA-256; download wired; rename/delete/restore owner-only; restore sends {confirm:true}; destructive actions confirmed.
List/download/restore/rename/delete routes with confirmation, owner role, CSRF/audit filters.
Serialized creation uses temporary files, records length/SHA-256 metadata, and applies retention.
Rename/delete compensate filesystem changes when metadata persistence fails; restore uses temporary replacement and rollback.
SafeName/Contained enforce basename, extension, and root containment.
Scheduled creation skips while supervisor reports running.

next_slice.summary: Harden create/prune to compensate metadata persistence failures and add focused API integration coverage for role/CSRF/running/confirmation/download behavior if feasible.
